model_annotation:
Both plots share the same x-axis and y-axis. The x-axis is labeled "Batch size" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 512, and tick labels at 1, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and 512. The y-axis is labeled "Inference time (seconds)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 10 in the first plot and 0 to 30 in the second plot.

The first plot illustrates the inference time for three models - Llama-1B, Llamba-1B, and MambaInLlama1B - across different batch sizes. Llama-1B is represented by a blue line with a solid style, starting at around 4 seconds at a batch size of 1 and increasing to approximately 6 seconds at a batch size of 300. Llamba-1B is depicted by an orange line with a dashed style, beginning at about 2 seconds at a batch size of 1 and rising to roughly 3.5 seconds at a batch size of 300. MambaInLlama1B is shown as a red line with a dotted style, starting at around 2 seconds at a batch size of 1 and reaching approximately 3.5 seconds at a batch size of 300.

The second plot compares the inference time for three models - Llama-3B, Llamba-4B, and MambaInLlama-3B - across different batch sizes. Llama-3B is represented by a blue line with a solid style, starting at around 6 seconds at a batch size of 1 and increasing to approximately 20 seconds at a batch size of 512. Llamba-4B is depicted by an orange line with a dashed style, beginning at about 2.6 seconds at a batch size of 1 and rising to roughly 7.5 seconds at a batch size of 512. MambaInLlama-3B is shown as a red line with a dotted style, starting at around 2.6 seconds at a batch size of 1 and reaching approximately 5 seconds at a batch size of 512.
